title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Emergency Rescue Service Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Emergency Rescue Service Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 2020
ACT VI OF 2020
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EMERGENCY RESCUE
SERVICE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Emergency Rescue Service Act, 2012
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
13th January, 2020]
No. PA/Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa/Bills-81/2020/813. dated 13.1.2020.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Emergency Rescue Service
(Amendment) Bill, 2019 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 2nd January, 2020 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 8th January, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Emergency Rescue
Service Act, 2012 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XV of 2012), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Emergency Rescue Service (Amendment)
Act, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
